issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְכָל הַמִּישֹׁר' means 'and all the plain/tableland' (מִישֹׁר = level country/plain), but the Chinese renders it as '一切公平之地' ('all fair/righteous places'), which misinterprets the geographical term as a moral/ethical concept. This changes the factual meaning from a geographic region to an abstract quality.
